English: Forge Hut
A modest timber hut sheltering a small forge, allowing a resident smith to create nails, horseshoes, and simple tools for townsfolk.
Anvil Shed
A humble, makeshift shelter of wood and earth, housing a single anvil for basic repairs and toolmaking at the city edge.
Smithy Workshop
A permanent wattle-and-daub structure with a stone hearth and a water barrel, enabling regular production of tools, horseshoes, and basic fittings.
Ironmongers Shop
A bustling city shop with a permanent forge, retail front, and apprentices, selling a wide variety of iron goods to merchants and citizens.
Bladesmiths Forge
A specialized smithy with multiple forges and skilled craftsmen, producing quality blades, tools, and fittings for the city and trade.
Armorers Hall
A prominent guild hall with reinforced workshops and living quarters, producing fine armor, weapons, and city defenses for both militia and trade.
Weaponworks
A large walled compound with numerous forges, supply stores, and a small garrison, focused on mass producing armaments for the city guard and trade.
Metalsmith Guild
A powerful and wealthy guild with chartered privileges, grand halls, and oversight of the citys smiths, boosting industry, trade, and civic pride.
Foundry Complex
A sprawling industrial district of blast furnaces, workshops, and storehouses, processing ore and manufacturing advanced goods for city and export.
Master Smithy
The grandest smithing institution in the realm: a fortified complex of master craftsmen, rare materials, and secret techniques, fueling city prosperity and prestige.
